name: awaitless
description: Durable local, SSH, and Slurm command execution for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Run builds, tests, benchmarks, and other non-interactive commands through a durable execution layer. Quick work returns inline; longer or queued work remains recoverable across local, SSH, and Slurm environments.
defaultPrompt: Run this project's test suite through Awaitless.
Start this long command and return when it finishes.
Run these independent jobs and collect their results.
